description: This file defines data structures and functions related to wake word detection, including segments, configuration, matches, and the core matching logic with auxiliary methods for text normalization and processing.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment in the wake word detection process with text, timing, and optional range info.

classes.name: WakeWordGateConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for wake word detection, including triggers and timing constraints.

classes.name: WakeWordGateMatch
classes.description: Represents a successful match of a wake word with associated timing and command.

classes.name: WakeWordGate
classes.description: Contains static methods for matching wake words within transcripts and segments.

classes.name: WakeWordSpeechSegments
classes.description: Provides a method to convert Speech framework transcription segments into WakeWordSegments.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Main method to find a wake word match in transcript and segments based on provided config.

methods.name: commandText
methods.description: Extracts command text following the wake word trigger time from segments.

methods.name: matchesTextOnly
methods.description: Checks if the given text contains any trigger words, normalized for case and punctuation.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes trigger words from the beginning of text, normalizing the output.

methods.name: normalizeTriggers
methods.description: Converts trigger strings into normalized tokens for matching.

methods.name: normalizeSegments
methods.description: Converts segments into normalized tokens for matching.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a single token by trimming and lowercasing.

methods.name: from (in WakeWordSpeechSegments)
methods.description: Converts SFTranscription segments into WakeWordSegment objects.
